actions.title: Inspect without changing state
actions.instruction: Run the installed Academy Doctor command from the repository. Read the repository path, Git state, current branch, origin, and upstream before taking another action.
actions.rationale: The read-only Doctor snapshot keeps repository diagnosis separate from recovery changes; Inspect is a presentation, not another operation.
actions.expected_result: Doctor reports each available repository boundary and makes no repository change.
actions.recovery: If Doctor cannot identify a Git repository, stop and follow the Repository not found decision below.
actions.evidence: The report records the state you observed before recovery.

actions.title: Return to the named attempt branch
actions.instruction: Replace <attempt-branch> with the exact numbered branch printed by the Doctor snapshot, then run the command in a Native terminal. Do not guess a branch name.
actions.rationale: Switching to an existing named branch preserves commits and restores the lesson's intended working context.
actions.expected_result: Git reports that the exact numbered attempt branch is checked out and preserves its existing commits.
actions.recovery: If Git refuses because of local changes, do not force the switch; return to the Dirty worktree decision and preserve those paths.
actions.evidence: A new Doctor snapshot names the intended numbered attempt branch.

actions.title: Restore the learner-safe remote contract
actions.instruction: Replace YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT with the GitHub account that owns your fork, then run the complete variant in a Native terminal from the clone.
actions.rationale: The explicit fetch, push, upstream-disable, default, and current-branch settings prevent an inherited push target from bypassing the learner fork.

variants.command:
git config --unset-all remote.origin.url 2>$null
git config --add remote.origin.url https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.origin.pushurl 2>$null
git config --add remote.origin.pushurl https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.url 2>$null
git config --add remote.upstream.url https://github.com/arbiterForge/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.pushurl 2>$null
git config --add remote.upstream.pushurl DISABLED
git config remote.pushDefault origin
$branch = git branch --show-current
if ($branch) { git config "branch.$branch.pushRemote" origin }

git config --unset-all remote.origin.url || true
git config --add remote.origin.url https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.origin.pushurl || true
git config --add remote.origin.pushurl https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.url || true
git config --add remote.upstream.url https://github.com/arbiterForge/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.pushurl || true
git config --add remote.upstream.pushurl DISABLED
git config remote.pushDefault origin
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then git config "branch.$branch.pushRemote" origin; fi

git config --unset-all remote.origin.url || true
git config --add remote.origin.url https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.origin.pushurl || true
git config --add remote.origin.pushurl https://github.com/YOUR-GITHUB-ACCOUNT/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.url || true
git config --add remote.upstream.url https://github.com/arbiterForge/arbiter-academy.git
git config --unset-all remote.upstream.pushurl || true
git config --add remote.upstream.pushurl DISABLED
git config remote.pushDefault origin
branch=$(git branch --show-current)
if [ -n "$branch" ]; then git config "branch.$branch.pushRemote" origin; fi

actions.expected_result: Doctor reports origin fetch and push on your fork, upstream fetch on the official Academy repository, upstream push disabled, and effective push routing to origin.
actions.recovery: If any command reports an error, stop before pushing, preserve the complete output, and run Doctor again to identify the remaining mismatch.
actions.evidence: The Doctor snapshot records the complete learner-safe remote contract.

actions.title: Read the authoritative lesson result
actions.instruction: Replace <lab-id> with the lesson ID from the lesson page or current academy/<lab-id>/<attempt> branch, without typing angle brackets. Run Check only after the Doctor snapshot identifies the intended numbered attempt.
actions.rationale: The installed Academy checker evaluates the selected repository as untrusted input.
actions.expected_result: Check either passes or names the exact unmet lesson requirement.
actions.recovery: If there is no prepared attempt, return to the lesson and Prepare once. If Check fails, preserve the report and follow that lesson's recovery text.
actions.evidence: The Check report belongs with the numbered attempt.

actions.title: Create the next documented attempt
actions.instruction: Replace <lab-id> with the same lesson ID used for Check, without typing angle brackets. Run Reset only after the current attempt evidence is committed, the worktree is clean, and the remotes are safe.
actions.rationale: Reset keeps the failed attempt and creates the next numbered attempt through one bounded operation.
actions.expected_result: Academy reports the archived attempt and the next prepared attempt number.
actions.recovery: If Reset refuses, keep the current state, run Doctor, and resolve only the condition it reports.
actions.evidence: Both numbered attempt branches remain available.

actions.title: Return to the course base
actions.instruction: Run this native-terminal handoff only after Check has examined committed evidence. It refuses unless the worktree is clean, the current branch is a numbered Academy attempt, and local main exists.
actions.rationale: The preflight leaves the numbered attempt branch and its commits intact, then uses the already taught git switch main command without inventing an Academy route.
actions.expected_result: Git switches to main while the numbered attempt branch and its commits remain reachable.
actions.recovery: If the preflight refuses, keep the attempt open and resolve only the named dirty-worktree, branch, or missing-main condition; do not force the switch or delete the attempt.
actions.evidence: The attempt branch and evidence commits remain reachable after returning to main.
